name: Lushang Freda Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd.
summary: Lushang Freda Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, raw materials, and additives in China. It is involved in property management services. The company provides facial cleansers, lotions, creams, sprays, masks, and other products. It also offers products in the field of dermatology, orthopedics, ophthalmology, gynecology, and pediatrics, respiratory, endocrinology, andrology, tonic, and plasters, as well as hyaluronic acid and its derivatives, bio-fermentation, plant extracts, chemical synthesis, tablets, capsules, drinks, injections, granules, and other products.
